name: Vertex AI model behind vLLM's API
description: An OpenAI-compatible server on vLLM's port that answers from Vertex AI in the workspace's project, as the VM's service account: with a Gemini model, or with a model such as Nemotron that the workspace serves on a Vertex AI endpoint of its own. Lets the app run without a GPU: OpenCode keeps the address it uses with vLLM.
